certification.name: HackTricks AWS Red Team Expert
certification.description: Covers AWS identity and access management, encryption, networking protections and misconfigurations across more than 20 AWS services, with red team and whitebox methodologies. Certification requires passing a practical exam of lab challenges solved by submitting flags within 12 hours; no report is required.
